consequences: No change to five-minute threshold, ten-second polling, provider budgets or delivery model. A retained candidate is advisory; concurrent refresh wins over recovery. Terminal event repair remains idempotent.
context: Periodic recovery selects stale rows before marking them failed. Deterministic cross-connection tests reproduce a heartbeat renewal or turn update between these operations; ordinary transition wrongly fails resumed work.
decision: Recheck nonterminal status, stale timestamp and matching live lease inside the same SQLite write that marks a turn failed. Acquisition validates conversation and nonterminal turn identity; renewal excludes terminal turns so recovered executions lose lease on their next heartbeat.
title: Atomic stale-turn recovery and lease terminal fence
